original_goal: Small future-preserving generative/transition representation under limited resources; assess total projection/discovery/proof/use cost in existing P4 synthetic GF(2) domain without claiming general reasoning.
original_AC_ref: Issue #71 C6 (size/cost of phi delta checker discovery and real total end-to-end effect)
current_decision: For one fixed 128bit, 2-action output-stream workload, does auto-derived 2bit quotient reduce inclusive cost compared with the fastest admissible optimized no-projection raw execution?

previous_evidence.P4: 128→2 algebraic future-preserving quotient for known GF(2) transition, no total cost measured
previous_evidence.direct_baseline: column XOR and byte-block-LUT exact for all 128bit raw states by basis identity (2026-11-07 precheck)

fixed_scope.initial_state: 8 independent uniformly seeded 128bit raw states (Python random.Random seed 20261107)
fixed_scope.operation_stream: Each initial state takes N uniform action0/1; common generated streams for all methods
fixed_scope.observable: 1bit output after every action, identical stream for all methods; correctness tested at every step
fixed_scope.preprocessing: each method constructs method-specific lookup or quotient once per deployment; source matrix construction common to all and separately recorded
fixed_scope.representation: Python integers with 128 bit raw state; Python 2bit quotient from source-aware algebraic closure
fixed_scope.cache_policy: no output-word cache; no repeated identical-prefix memoization; method-owned precomputed matrices/LUT allowed inside memory cap
fixed_scope.language: same CPython process and same source functions; monotonic perf_counter_ns
fixed_scope.resource_limit: time budget ~60s or fail/UNKNOWN; no off-machine/hardware tests

methods.name: raw_row_parity
methods.desc: source 128 x 128 row parity update; baseline diagnostic not used as fastest fair benchmark

methods.name: raw_column_xor
methods.desc: no-projection, 128bit raw state; cached per-action 128 source columns; column XOR dynamic update

methods.name: raw_byte_lut
methods.desc: no-projection, 128bit raw state; 16 byte-block per-action 256-entry tables; 16 lookup/XOR each update

methods.name: projected_2bit
methods.desc: source-aware quotient() derived phi/delta/readout from observed row and source transition; one phi per initial raw state then only 2bit delta

provenance.independent_math: check phi*M_a == delta_a*phi and O==h*phi on all source basis via row identities, closure rank and injected mutation rejection

predicted_pass: 8 streams*2048 observations correct for all methods; quotient TOTAL (build phi+delta + independent checker + eight init phi + 8*2048 execution, excluding common source creation) <= 0.90 x fastest admissible direct raw TOTAL with method build included and <=2 MiB tables, 7-run median; source-inspected known-linear domain only
predicted_fail: incorrect stream outputs OR quotient total >= 0.90 x best admissible optimized no-projection total (>=0.9 means no >=10% margin)
ambiguous_rule: If repeated per-method cost distributions overlap substantially or extrapolation/scope/independent proof breaks, record UNKNOWN; do not claim either unique practical speed benefit or generality. Less than 10% margin means not useful in this predeclared task despite exact correctness.
causality_control: Compare method-specific precomputation + actual runtime; account for source matrices common to all; the baseline is fastest of column-xor and byte-block-LUT that fits memory cap; report row parity separately. State compression does not imply speed or minimum program length.
outputs: per-method 7-run medians for build, time+total at N=1/16/256/2048
independent correctness and one mutation rejection
actual 128bit source/method table memory footprint estimated by recursive sys.getsizeof and fixed theoretical payload
observed resource use including quotient discovery and independent checker
decision vs original C6 and uncertainties
stop_rule: One bounded workload, no automatic follow-on PoC; if baseline has hidden phi/coordinate leakage, fail and repair comparator instead of success claim.
